preconditions.description: Input constraints: number of cities n, initial roads m, and queries q must satisfy given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in query_x) and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in query_xy)
preconditions.description: All city references in queries are within valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0] == '2' for line in query_lines if line.startswith('2')) or all(len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0] == '1' for line in query_lines if line.startswith('1'))
preconditions.description: Each query is either a type-1 (single city) or type-2 (two cities) request, properly formatted.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line) > 0 and stdout_line.isdigit() for stdout_line in stdout_lines if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each type-1 query, the output is a non-empty integer representing the length of the longest path in the region containing the queried city.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout_line) <= n - 1 for stdout_line in stdout_lines if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: The output for each type-1 query is a valid path length (between 0 and n-1).

postconditions.expression: all(region_contains(x, region_x) and region_contains(y, region_y) for (x, y), region_x, region_y in zip(query_xy, regions_x, regions_y))
postconditions.description: For each type-2 query, the regions of cities x and y are correctly identified before merging.

postconditions.expression: all(region_contains(x, region_y) or region_contains(y, region_x) for (x, y), region_x, region_y in zip(query_xy, regions_x, regions_y) if region_x != region_y)
postconditions.description: After a type-2 query, the regions of cities x and y are merged into a single region.

postconditions.expression: all(max_path_length(region) <= max_path_length(region_x) + max_path_length(region_y) + 1 for (x, y), region_x, region_y, region in zip(query_xy, regions_x, regions_y, merged_regions) if region_x != region_y)
postconditions.description: After merging regions, the longest path in the new region does not exceed the sum of the longest paths in the original regions plus one.

invariants.description: The set of roads always defines the current regions (connected components) of cities.

invariants.expression: all(region_contains(x, region) for x, region in zip(cities, regions))
invariants.description: Every city is always contained in exactly one region.
